<!-- # Hi!  -->

I'm an Assistant Teaching Professor in the Applied Math & Stats department <!-- why is Math singular but Stats plural? --> at Johns Hopkins University. <br />

I vibe-coded this app to visualize AMS courses: [https://apurvanakade.github.io/AMS-courses/](https://apurvanakade.github.io/AMS-courses/) <br />

I'm working on a project to build visualizations for various mathematical concepts as a tool for teaching and learning. The goal is to make math more accessible and engaging for students of all levels. You can check out the project here: [https://apurvanakade.github.io/VisualMath/](https://apurvanakade.github.io/VisualMath/)
